companyDescription: AI networking + custom ASIC (TPU-class compute) leader · Apple deal extended through 2031 · Q3 2026 earnings Jul 29 · Q3 guide $29.4B (from Q2's $22.2B)
priceNote: Live-prices.json cache (just refreshed, <1h old). Up 2.36% today. Morgan Stanley reiterated Buy with a $502 target this same day (Jul 14), citing continued confidence in Broadcom's AI/custom-chip leadership.
summary: Broadcom reports Q3 2026 earnings Jul 29 — landing directly in the dense FOMC/Big-Tech-earnings/PCE week, one of the most consequential single days of the quarter. Management already guided Q3 revenue to $29.4B, up sharply from Q2's $22.2B, reflecting continued AI-networking and custom-ASIC (TPU-class compute) momentum. The extended Apple partnership through 2031 underpins long-duration revenue visibility beyond the near-term AI cycle. 48-analyst consensus average $523.73 implies real upside from today's price, with Morgan Stanley reiterating Buy at $502 the same day as this report. Consensus remains strongly bullish despite a recent earnings miss earlier this year — worth watching whether Jul 29 breaks that pattern.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Reports Jul 29, 2026 — the same day as the FOMC decision. Company already guided Q3 revenue to $29.4B (from Q2's $22.2B), a sharp sequential jump reflecting AI networking and custom-ASIC demand. Watch for any update to full-year guidance and commentary on the TPU-based compute partnership pipeline.

catalysts.name: Apple Partnership Extension Through 2031
catalysts.description: Recently extended strategic partnership with Apple — long-duration revenue visibility that reduces reliance on any single AI-cycle year. A structural positive distinct from the quarter-to-quarter AI-capex narrative.

catalysts.name: AI Networking + Custom ASIC (TPU-Class) Pipeline
catalysts.description: Extensive customer roadmap for TPU-based compute and AI networking, with significant purchase orders already signaling forward growth. This is the core growth engine behind the Q3 guidance jump.

risks: Earnings land the SAME DAY as the FOMC decision (Jul 29) — even a clean beat could be overshadowed or amplified by the Fed's simultaneous announcement, adding a layer of noise to the pure stock-specific reaction

Consensus remains strongly bullish 'despite recent earnings misses' per current coverage — worth explicitly checking whether Jul 29 continues that miss pattern or breaks it, rather than assuming a clean beat by default
The jump from $22.2B (Q2) to $29.4B (Q3 guide) is a large sequential step — any signal that this pace isn't sustainable into Q4 would be read negatively even if Q3 itself is in-line
At a $1.85T market cap, AVGO needs genuinely large absolute dollar moves in AI/networking demand to move the needle — law-of-large-numbers effects apply
Analyst target range is fairly tight ($390-630) relative to some of today's other AI names, suggesting less room for a dramatic re-rate surprise in either direction compared to earlier-stage AI plays

estimateDates.note: Guided $29.4B revenue (from Q2's $22.2B) — lands same day as FOMC decision

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed holds at 3.50-3.75%, but Chair Warsh's hawkish Jun debut FOMC (9/18 officials projecting a 2026 hike) makes the Jul 28-29 decision itself a live risk — and AVGO's earnings land the exact same day as that decision.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE accelerated to 3.4% YoY (May) — reinforces the hawkish setup into the Jul 28-29 FOMC, which is one part of the same-day double-header AVGO faces.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: HIGH. This is a rare case where the macro event risk (FOMC) and the company-specific catalyst (earnings) land on the literal same day — whatever AVGO reports could be partially drowned out or amplified by the market's simultaneous reaction to the Fed decision.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk HIGH specifically because of the calendar collision — Jul 29 is both AVGO's earnings day AND the FOMC decision day, a genuinely unusual and elevated-volatility setup that deserves more caution than a typical earnings date would.

th.summary: Broadcom รายงาน Q3 2026 earnings 29 ก.ค. — ตรงวัน FOMC decision พอดี หนึ่งในวันสำคัญที่สุดของไตรมาส Management guide Q3 revenue ไว้แล้วที่ $29.4B เพิ่มขึ้นชัดเจนจาก Q2 ที่ $22.2B สะท้อน momentum AI-networking และ custom-ASIC (TPU-class compute) ต่อเนื่อง ดีล Apple ขยายถึง 2031 หนุน revenue visibility ระยะยาวเกินกว่า AI cycle ระยะสั้น Consensus เฉลี่ย 48 คน $523.73 = upside จริงจากราคาวันนี้ Morgan Stanley ย้ำ Buy ที่ $502 วันเดียวกับรายงานนี้ (14 ก.ค.) Consensus ยัง bullish มากแม้เคย miss earnings ก่อนหน้านี้ในปี — น่าจับตาว่า 29 ก.ค. จะทำลาย pattern นั้นได้ไหม
